concerns.text: Task T006 references `SC-004` ("satisfying SC-004") but no SC-004 is defined in the specification; this is a stale spec reference that must be removed or the corresponding success criterion added to spec.md.

Task T004 mentions `FR-006` and `FR-007` in its description, yet the specification only defines FR-001 through FR-004. These references are invalid and should be corrected to refer to existing FRs or the spec should be extended accordingly.
